caption: The drawing depicts a single, cylindrical jar with a lid placed on a plain, light-colored background. The jar is predominantly a reddish-brown color, with irregular, dark brown to nearly black spots distributed unevenly around its surface. The lid fits snugly on top, and the jar has a slightly flared rim. A lighter beige or tan band encircles the base of the jar. There are subtle highlights and reflections suggesting a glossy finish. The artist's signature, "S. Jerome Hoxie" and the year "'36," appear in small orange text near the lower right side of the drawing. The composition centers the jar, and no other objects or decorative elements are present.
title: Preserve Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
